mapper.sql: id, trace_id, run_id, operation_key, provider, model, outcome, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, error_summary, occurred_at
mapper.insert: insert into ai_llm_call_trace (trace_id, run_id, operation_key, provider, model, outcome, duration_ms, input_tokens, output_tokens, error_summary, occurred_at) values (#{traceId}, #{runId}, #{operationKey}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{outcome}, #{durationMs}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{errorSummary}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCalls, coalesce(sum(case when outcome = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as successCalls, coalesce(avg(duration_ms), 0) as averageDurationMs, coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as inputTokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as outputTokens from ai_llm_call_trace where occurred_at >= #{start}
